title: Notifications with timer to fade out get stuck on their last millisecond when the session is locked, and then visibly fade out after session is unlocked
line: Notifications that expire while the screen is locked no longer reappear and slide away after unlocking.
explanation: Notification popups are animated by KWin's sliding notifications effect, which advances its springs only when the window is painted. While the screen is locked nothing but the lock screen is painted, so a notification that closed (or opened) under the lock screen kept its animation frozen at the first frame and only played it after unlock: the expired popup appeared again and slid out. The effect now skips intro, outro and move animations while the screen is locked and drops running animations when the lock state changes.

commits.message:
plugins/slidingnotifications: don't animate notifications while locked

Animations only advance when the window is painted, so a notification
that closed under the lock screen stayed on its last frame and slid out
after unlocking. Skip them while locked and drop running ones on lock.

BUG: 497597

media.caption: First frames after unlocking: the notification that expired while locked is drawn again and slides out (frames 33 ms apart).
Same steps with the fix: no notification after unlocking.
Unlock recorded at 30 fps: the expired popup appears and slides away.
Same unlock with the fix: the desktop appears without the popup.
